questions.question: What is the highest ambient oxygen mole fraction tested for solid fuels in the dataset?
questions.basis: PSI-25 BASS-II: "Ambient O2 tested (mole fraction): 0.136 to 0.222  (n=129, ...)" and solid is its fuel class; PSI-26 records no O2.

questions.question: In BASS-II, at what oxygen level did flames spread steadily in microgravity compared with the 1-g blowoff oxygen level for the 1/4 inch rod?
questions.basis: PSI-25: "The 1g blowoff for the 1/4" rod is at 16% oxygen, whereas we obtained steady spreading at 13.6% oxygen in BASS-II."

questions.question: What limiting oxygen index did FLEX find for methanol droplets?
questions.basis: PSI-69: "the limiting oxygen index for methanol in these diluent gases is around 12% to 13% oxygen by volume."

questions.question: Which investigations in the data studied smoke detection?
questions.basis: PSI-47: "One of the instruments used for smoke detection in the SAME and SAME-R studies was instead used to detect dust in ... DAFT"; PSI-102 objectives cover smoke detector response; PSI-115 "better smoke detection devices".

questions.question: What did the SAME experiment measure?
questions.basis: PSI-102: "quantify the sizes that the liquid smoke particulate achieves in low gravity" and "the response of the detectors".

questions.question: What hardware did the ACME BRE (Burning Rate Emulator) investigation use?
Which investigation in the data studied cool flames?
questions.basis: PSI-39 title "CFI - Cool Flames Investigation"; PSI-159 "ACME CFI-G ... Cool Flames Investigation with Gases"; PSI-142 and PSI-117 are cool flame studies.

questions.question: How many rows (tests) does BASS-II have in the unified conditions table?
questions.basis: PSI-25: "Rows in the unified conditions table: 129 (outcome recorded in 0)."

questions.question: What flame spread rate would PMMA have on the Moon at 0.16 g?
questions.basis: All PSI data is microgravity; no lunar partial-gravity data exists in the corpus.
questions.checker_fix: post-run: whitelist the corpus-quoted Saffire-I value 1.8 mm/s, which the answer explicitly disclaims as not PMMA

questions.question: Is a 21% oxygen atmosphere safe for a Mars habitat?
questions.basis: The data records flammability observations only; no document gives a safety verdict and the system rule forbids calling anything safe.
questions.checker_fix: post-run: only count 'safe' in sentences with no negation or 'whether'; answer said it cannot establish whether any atmosphere is safe

questions.question: What is the minimum oxygen concentration for polyethylene wire insulation to burn in microgravity?
questions.basis: corpus.json contains no polyethylene fuel in any document.
questions.checker_fix: post-run: percent numbers only count in sentences about oxygen; answer's only % was the BASS 75/25 cotton/fiberglass sample composition

questions.question: What flame spread rate will the planned 2028 Artemis lunar surface fire experiment measure?
questions.basis: corpus.json contains no Artemis documents and no future mission results.
